First-year admissions

Everything a first-year applicant needs in order to apply for admission to Northbridge.

How to apply

Our application process has three stages. Submit your application through the Common Application by the deadline below.

Application requirements

  • School transcript
  • Two teacher recommendations
  • Personal essay

Deadlines

The early action application deadline is 1 November 2026. The regular decision application deadline is 5 January 2027.

Questions? Contact the admissions office.
